title: Visual web design for the Pilobil.us publication

comments.author: home
comments.text:
GOAL: the visual design for Pilobil.us as a Markus-rendered publication. Fully parallel to the renderer plumbing - it needs no Papyrus TypeScript at all.

CONTEXT: Pilobil.us ('a fungus among us') is a Papyrus pod at /Users/home/Projects/Pilobol.us. Read doctrine/pilobil.md there for editorial voice. It will render through Markus (Markdown + semantic directives -> static HTML), NOT through the Pretext layout solver.

WHY YOU CAN START NOW: Markus renders standalone. 'markus' is installed (/Users/home/miniconda3/bin/markus) and /Users/home/Projects/Markus has the source, 23 themes in src/markusmd/themes/, and tokens as --markus-* CSS custom properties. You can author Markdown, run 'markus convert', and iterate on CSS in a browser without waiting on anything.

SCOPE:
1. Design the Pilobil.us look: masthead, typography, color, section treatment, article page, index page.
2. Deliver it as a SITE CSS LAYER over Markus's tokens - redefine --markus-* rather than fighting Markus's selectors. Either pick and adapt an existing theme or write a new one; say which and why.
3. CASCADE RULE (decided, non-negotiable): wrap vendored Markus CSS in '@layer markus { ... }' at vendor time so we own the cascade deterministically. Do NOT rely on upstream Markus happening not to use @layer - that is a bet on someone else's future commits.
4. Design for BOTH light and dark. Markus themes carry both; do not ship a design that only works in one.
5. Exercise the real vocabulary in your sample page: pull-quote, card-grid/card, two-up, figure, callout, aside, metric. These constructs are the whole point of the architecture - a plain-prose mockup proves nothing.
6. Deliverable: real HTML+CSS openable in a browser, plus the Markdown source that produced it. Screenshots alone are not enough.

DO NOT: touch lib/renderer.ts, renderers/pretext/, or any Papyrus route. This is CSS + Markdown + Markus.
